questions.stem: If a student has flu symptoms and is still attending school, what is the best way to prevent the spread of infection?
choices: Share a water bottle with them
Avoid close contact and use a mask
questions.solution: Avoiding close contact and using a mask helps prevent the spread of flu, which is a communicable disease. Sharing a water bottle or touching their belongings increases the risk of transmission.

hi.stem: यदि कोई छात्र फ्लू के लक्षण रखता है और अभी भी स्कूल जा रहा है, तो संक्रमण के फैलाव को रोकने का सबसे अच्छा तरीका क्या है?

hi.solution: निकट संपर्क से बचना और मास्क का उपयोग करना फ्लू के फैलाव को रोकता है, जो एक संक्रामक बीमारी है। जल बोतल साझा करना या उनकी वस्तुओं को छूना संक्रमण के जोखिम को बढ़ाता है।

questions.stem: If a person is suffering from a viral infection like the flu, what should they do?
questions.solution: Rest and drink water is the correct approach for a viral infection. Antibiotics are ineffective against viruses, and eating more sugar or avoiding food is not advisable.

hi.stem: यदि कोई व्यक्ति फ्लू जैसे विषाणु संक्रमण से पीड़ित है, तो वे क्या करना चाहिए?
hi.solution: विषाणु संक्रमण के लिए आराम करना और पानी पीना सही उपाय है। एंटीबायोटिक विषाणुओं पर कार्य नहीं करते हैं, और अधिक शर्बत खाना या भोजन से बचना उपयुक्त नहीं है।

questions.stem: What is the main way to prevent the spread of diseases like typhoid and cholera?
choices: Avoiding close contact with sick people
Drinking boiled water and eating properly cooked food
questions.solution: Drinking boiled water and eating properly cooked food is the main way to prevent diseases like typhoid and cholera because they are spread through contaminated food and water. Avoiding close contact and keeping personal items separate help prevent other diseases, and vaccination is important for some diseases but not all.

hi.stem: टाइफॉइड और हैजा जैसी बीमारियों के फैलाव को रोकने का मुख्य तरीका क्या है?

questions.stem: In a school, a flu outbreak occurs, and some students are absent while others are symptomatic. What should be the first step taken by the school?
questions.solution: Isolating affected students is the first step to prevent the spread of flu. Starting a health campaign or providing antibiotics is not the immediate action, and cancelling classes is not a practical solution.

questions.stem: In a school with a flu outbreak, what is the best way to prevent the spread of the disease?
questions.solution: Washing hands regularly is the most effective way to prevent the spread of flu. Sharing personal items, ignoring symptoms, and visiting crowded places can increase the risk of transmission.

questions.stem: If a student spends too much time on social media, what effect might it have on their health?
choices: It can improve their mental health
It can lead to loneliness and health issues
It can make them more socially connected
questions.solution: Spending too much time on social media can lead to loneliness and health issues because excessive use often reduces face-to-face interactions and can contribute to stress or poor sleep. Improved mental health and increased social connection are unlikely outcomes as they contradict the negative effects associated with overuse. Increased appetite is not directly linked to social media use in this context.

questions.stem: If a farmer uses antibiotics in animal feed, what could be a possible consequence?
choices: The antibiotics will not affect the animals
The bacteria in the animals may become resistant
The antibiotics will eliminate all bacteria in the animals
questions.solution: Antibiotics can kill some bacteria, but the ones that survive may have genetic traits that make them resistant. Over time, these resistant bacteria can multiply and become more common. The other options are incorrect because antibiotics can affect animal health, but they do not eliminate all bacteria, and they can have effects on the animals themselves.

hi.stem: यदि किसान जानवरों के खाद्य में एंटीबायोटिक्स का उपयोग करता है, तो संभावित परिणाम क्या हो सकता है?
choices: एंटीबायोटिक्स जानवरों पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं डालेगा
जानवरों में रोगजनक एंटीबायोटिक प्रतिरोधी हो सकते हैं
एंटीबायोटिक्स जानवरों में सभी रोगजनकों को नष्ट कर देंगे
hi.solution: एंटीबायोटिक्स कुछ रोगजनकों को मार सकते हैं, लेकिन जो बच जाते हैं उनमें आनुवंशिक गुण हो सकते हैं जो उन्हें प्रतिरोधी बना देते हैं। समय के साथ, ये प्रतिरोधी रोगजनक बढ़ सकते हैं और अधिक सामान्य हो सकते हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि एंटीबायोटिक्स जानवरों के स्वास्थ्य पर प्रभाव डाल सकते हैं, लेकिन वे सभी रोगजनकों को नष्ट नहीं करते हैं, और वे जानवरों पर अपना प्रभाव डाल सकते हैं।

questions.stem: A student is offered a cigarette at a party. What is the best way to respond without being rude?
choices: Take the cigarette and smoke it
Say no politely and walk away
questions.solution: Saying no politely and walking away is the best way to avoid smoking while being considerate. Taking the cigarette or arguing is not a good response.

questions.stem: What is the most effective way to prevent the spread of a disease like dengue fever?
choices: Using a mask in crowded places
questions.solution: Dengue is spread by mosquitoes, so controlling mosquito populations is the most effective way to prevent it. Using a mask, keeping personal items separate, and avoiding contaminated food and water are more relevant for other types of diseases.

hi.stem: डेंगू बुखार जैसे रोग के फैलाव को रोकने का सबसे कारगर तरीका क्या है?
choices: भीड़ वाले स्थानों में मास्क का उपयोग करना

questions.stem: Why should antibiotics not be taken for a viral infection like a cold?
choices: They can cause resistance in viruses
They can cause resistance in bacteria
questions.solution: Antibiotics are only effective against bacterial infections, not viral infections. Taking them for a cold is not helpful and can lead to antibiotic resistance.

questions.stem: Which of the following best explains why diseases like malaria are more common in certain regions?
choices: Because people do not wash hands frequently
Because of the presence of mosquitoes
questions.solution: Malaria is spread by mosquitoes, which are vectors. The presence of mosquitoes in certain regions makes these areas more prone to malaria. Hand washing, nutrition, and sanitation affect other types of diseases, not malaria specifically.
